name: text-area
title: Text Area
description: A multi-line text input with label, help text, validation, optional auto-resize and a character counter.

examples.name: text-area-counter
examples.title: Character counter
examples.description: Shown when maxLength is set; announced only near and at the limit.

examples.name: text-area-auto-resize
examples.title: Auto-resize
examples.description: Grows with the text up to maxRows, then scrolls.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, linked to the control. Without one, pass aria-label.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown with an icon when invalid. Defaults to the browser or validate() message.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Example text. Not a substitute for a label.

props.name: rows
props.description: Visible rows; also the minimum height when autoResize is on.

props.name: autoResize
props.description: Grow with the content instead of showing a resize handle.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: With autoResize, stop growing after this many rows.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Hard limit (native maxlength) and turns on the counter.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Marks the field required (native required + a decorative asterisk on the label).

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Forces the invalid state (aria-invalid, danger border, error message).

props.name: validate
props.description: Custom validation; return an error message to show.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the text area.

notes: The visible counter is aria-hidden; a polite live region announces only when 10% of the limit remains and when the limit is reached.
The counter turns warning then danger colour, and the number itself changes, so it is not colour-only.
Live-region messages are English; wrap or fork to localise.

do: Size rows to the expected answer length.
Use maxLength with a counter when there is a real limit (e.g. a statement note).
dont: Don't use a text area for single-line data like names or amounts.
Don't set maxRows so low that people can't review what they wrote.
